plan: A stoneweaver mage who throws her enemies into her mines and rides a wall across the map.
aSurveiller: Her W (Seismic Shove). It knocks you up, often into her mines (E): don't dash at her through her field.
contrer: Don't dash through her mines (E): they explode.
Dodge her W: it knocks you in one direction.
Her R creates a wall that can split you up: regroup.
faiblesses: Her spells are easy to see coming.

momentFort.voie: Strong in the early and mid game.
momentFort.jungle: Ganks very hard once she has her 3 spells. At level 6, her wall lets her reach any lane quickly.
